title: Daily Market Digest: October 28, 2026
subtitle: US Equities Close Higher, Driven by Tech and AI Enthusiasm Ahead of Fed Decision

items.headline: US Equities Post Gains Amid Tech Rally and Expected Fed Hold
items.summary: U.S. stock markets closed higher today, buoyed by a robust rebound in artificial intelligence (AI) related stocks and positive economic data. All three major indices finished in positive territory as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision, widely expected to be a hold. Optimism around tech earnings from major players like Microsoft and Alphabet, due after the close, also contributed to the upward momentum, despite concerns over rising crude oil prices and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

items.statContext: Advanced 1.2% (+308.43 points) on the day, driven by strong AI bigwigs.
Rose 16 points (+0.03%) in a choppy session.

items.headline: Manhattan Associates Surges on Strong Q3
items.summary: Shares of Manhattan Associates ($MANH) climbed +15% after the company reported record third-quarter results, showcasing 28% cloud revenue growth and raising its full-year revenue outlook.

items.headline: Vertiv Jumps on Raised Forecast
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co saw its shares rise +14.0% to +16.0% after beating third-quarter expectations and raising its full-year profit and revenue forecasts, benefiting from soaring demand for data-center equipment.

items.headline: Micron Technology Rallies on AI Demand
items.summary: Micron Technology ($MU) gained +4.7%, as the demand for memory chips is being propelled by the rising adoption and usage of artificial intelligence.

items.headline: Enphase Energy Falls on Weak Q4 Outlook
items.summary: Enphase Energy ($ENPH) dropped -16.8% to -17.7% after forecasting lower fourth-quarter sales. The company cited soft home solar demand, higher interest rates, and a lost tax credit as key factors.

items.headline: F5 Networks Slides Despite Earnings Beat
items.summary: F5 Networks ($FFIV) shares fell -18.04% despite reporting a beat on its fourth-quarter earnings and revenue, indicating investor concerns likely stemming from forward-looking guidance or other underlying issues.

items.headline: Boeing Declines on Production Slowdown Signal
items.summary: Boeing shares experienced a -10.7% decline after management signaled a slower-than-expected ramp in 737 Max production, erasing approximately $14.5 billion of its market value.

items.headline: Fed Meeting Concludes: Rates Expected to Hold Steady
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting concludes today, October 28, with a policy statement scheduled for 2 PM ET. Markets widely anticipate the Federal Reserve will maintain current interest rates in the 3.75%-4.00% range, though attention will be on any forward guidance from Chairman Kevin Warsh.

items.headline: Microsoft and Alphabet Set to Report Q3 Earnings Post-Market
items.summary: Key technology giants Microsoft ($MSFT) and Alphabet ($GOOGL) are slated to release their third-quarter earnings reports after market close today. Investors are closely watching these results for insights into cloud growth and the continued impact of AI investments on their businesses.

items.headline: Technology and Semiconductors Lead; Energy Lags
items.summary: The Information Technology Select Sector SPDR (XLK) rose 1.7%, with the semiconductor space experiencing a notable rebound. The PHLX Semiconductor (SOX) advanced 3.6%. Conversely, the Energy Select Sector SPDR (XLE) fell 2.1%. While crude oil prices saw an intraday pullback, they advanced by day's end to over $111 per barrel due to Middle East instability, presenting a mixed picture for the sector's components.

items.headline: Consumer Confidence Exceeds Expectations; Commodity Prices Projected to Rise
items.summary: U.S. consumer confidence for October climbed to 91.7%, surpassing consensus estimates, indicating strong economic sentiment. Meanwhile, the World Bank Group's latest outlook projects commodity prices to rise 23% in 2026, with energy prices potentially increasing by 32% due to global shocks and the ongoing Middle East conflict.

items.headline: Bank of Canada Raises Interest Rate Amid Worsening Inflation
items.summary: In international news, the Bank of Canada today announced an interest rate hike, citing a worsening inflation outlook. This move highlights diverging monetary policy actions between global central banks as they grapple with inflationary pressures.
